The University of Hull GREAT Scholarship 2025-26 is an opportunity offered by the University of Hull in partnership with the British Council and the GREAT Britain Campaign. Under this scheme, a total of 6 students will get a chance to study any full-time postgraduate course at the University of Hull. The selected candidate will receive financial support of a minimum of £10,000 for the one-year postgraduate study.
To be eligible, an applicant must -
have received an offer of a postgraduate degree program at the University of Hull
have a high level of performing/composition ability
have not previously studied in the UK
have achieved IELTS 6.5 overall with 5.5 in each skill or equivalent before the deadline of the application
The selected scholar will receive £10,000 in the form of a tuition fee reduction for their postgraduate program.
